title: DOCS-2334: Add frustum streaming guide
body:
## Changes

- Add new frustum streaming guide at `/workspace/streaming/frustum.md` covering camera-view-based instance streaming.
- Add frustum streaming to the Instance Streaming sidebar navigation.
- Update the instance streaming index page alert to link to the new frustum streaming guide.

### Provenance

- Source Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1tp_mtw1fxhZRcWnmUYB-AU7KPqICRMAO3pfZYpxKMc8/edit?tab=t.0
- Jira ticket: https://roblox.atlassian.net/browse/DOCS-2334

### Merge blockers

- [ ] DevForum announcement URL is a placeholder — needs the real URL once published.
- [ ] `Class.Player.FrustumStreaming` and `Enum.FrustumStreamingMode` API members should be verified in the engine reference once public.
